posting.title: Support Worker
posting.description:
We're looking for a dedicated Support Worker with
The passion to put the heart into care and make a difference to the quality of life for the residents you care for. We are looking for you to be reliable, committed and a good team-player with a passion for supporting individuals with daily skills. You will be required to have;

4-Months UK care experience from within the past 3-years
Moving and Handling
Personal care experience may be required
The right to work in the UK
A driving licence is required

Some of your your expected duties as a Support Worker will be:

Supporting individuals with daily tasks
Supporting with laundry and cleaning
Assisting with excursions with the individuals you support
Supporting with meals times.
Getting involved with and helping with activities.

Join us today to be a part of a team that puts the HEART into CARE.
Job description

Starting salary £14.29 per hour up to £18.77 for bank holidays.
You can make a difference and help put the heart into care by becoming a Support Worker for BIGANT Healthcare.
We are looking for a dedicated and reliable Support Worker to join our team in Torquay and the surrounding areas such as Paignton, Brixham and Newton Abbot. You can earn up to £18.77 per hour (Bank holiday nights) including holiday pay.
In joining our team of Support Workers, you can enjoy additional benifits such as;

Weekly pay: Payment is processed and paid to you every Friday on receiveing a timesheet.
£150.00 Refer a friend Scheme: You can receive £100.00 for referering a friend and they can receive £50.00
Flexible shifts available: Choose full-time, Part-time, day and night shifts, Weekday, and weekend shifts through our app.
Daily support from the team: daily support availble for your needs from our dedicated office staff.
Free training: this is set for you at the start of your recruitment process with endless courses available.
Free welcome gift box: Goodies sent to you on completion of your recruitment stage with a free BIGANT Healthcare uniform when you book your first shift.
Free DBS: We complete a DBS for you FREE OF CHARGE.
